ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the population of grasshopper decreases, the population of mouse will most likely do what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web with labels including Grass, Grasshopper, Mouse, Toad, Spider, Sparrow, and Hawk. The label Grasshopper appears in the lower-left/middle area, and Mouse appears near the lower middle-right. There is an arrow leading from Grasshopper toward Mouse. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows show the direction of food or energy flow, from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Since the arrow goes from Grasshopper to Mouse, the mouse depends on grasshoppers as a food source. If the grasshopper population decreases, mice would have less food available, so the mouse population would most likely decrease.
